featured_reviews.review_text:
It's a pretty big stationery shop.
They have a vast collection of assorted items which go beyond the scope of just stationery.
It is likely that you will find what you are looking for, or at least a substitute for that, if not that very precise brand.
It is definitely worth a visit.
Was moderately crowded, which was not entirely unexpected.
They provide free parking up to 45 minutes, which is quite useful if you know what you want.
But if you are exploring because of the assorted variety, you are likely to run over that time limit.
All in all, it's a good resourceful place, in my opinion.

featured_reviews.name: Taanishq R Patekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently visited [Padmavati Book Store ] and it was delightful! The cozy atmosphere and well-curated selection make it a gem. They also offer book rentals at unbeatable prices, making it an excellent choice for budget-conscious readers. Highly recommended for book lovers looking for a quaint spot to find great reads!

featured_reviews.name: Shabeer Mohamedappa
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a book library, including a semi-stationery store. You can rent books for reading and even sell old books here. The rental fees are reasonable, and they take a security deposit to ensure the safe return of their books. Despite its small size, you can find all popular book titles at this shop. It's a typical retail shop and do not offer any space to sit and read. They accept both cash and GPay. Overall, it's a decent book shop in the Goregaon area.

featured_reviews.name: Aakanksha Ahire
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of the best book stores in the Suburbs. With a massive collection of novels, new and classic, this bookstore is truly a heaven for all those who love to read (children and adults alike). With so many purchasing and renting options available, Padmavati Bookstore is one of a kind. The next time you're in Goregaon, this place should be a must-visit!

Its crowded later in the day. Not many xerox shops around. Its on a busy road so there is super high noise pollution at peak hours. My transaction here was farely quick as i only neesed transparent folders.
